name: How does kitchen size affect appliance selection and layout?

mainEntity.name: How does kitchen size affect appliance selection and layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen size significantly impacts appliance selection and layout. Smaller kitchens benefit from compact or multi-functional appliances, and a linear or galley layout to maximize space. Larger kitchens offer more flexibility for dedicated zones (e.g., baking, coffee bar) and larger appliances like double ovens or professional-grade ranges. The available footprint dictates the size and number of appliances you can comfortably incorporate while maintaining adequate counter space and safe clearances, especially for appliance doors and walkways.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen size determines appliance selection and layout; smaller kitchens need compact options, while larger ones allow for more appliances and specialized zones, impacting overall functionality.
